rules.action: Exclude from customer-level RFM, churn and cohort datasets; do not impute IDs
rules.justification: A synthetic customer ID would fabricate longitudinal customer history.

rules.action: Exclude from positive-sales table; preserve return/cancellation features
rules.justification: Cancellation rows are not completed positive sales but are useful for customer-behavior features.
RFM and positive commercial revenue use completed positive-quantity purchases.
Zero or negative unit-price rows do not represent positive commercial revenue.
Time-series and cohort calculations require valid dates.

revenue_definition: Primary positive-sales revenue = original Quantity * original Price for valid completed positive sales. IQR-capped helper fields are not used to rewrite headline revenue.

imputation.Customer ID: Not imputed; excluded from longitudinal customer analysis

outlier_capping.purpose: Robust analytical/modeling helper fields; original Quantity, Price and Revenue are preserved for headline commercial metrics.
